cases.sentence: Сын мой, не забывай моего ___ и в сердце храни мои повеления.
cases.translation: My son, do not forget my teaching and keep my commandments in your heart.
cases.explain: After забывай (forget), the genitive case is used.

cases.translation: Write them on the tablet of your heart.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) with prepositional case indicates location.

cases.sentence: Тогда ты найдешь ___ и доброе имя у Бога.
cases.translation: Then you will find favor and good reputation with God.
cases.explain: Расположение (favor) is the direct object of найдешь (you will find).

cases.sentence: Это принесет ___ твоему телу и укрепит твои кости.
cases.translation: This will bring health to your body and strengthen your bones.
cases.explain: Здоровье (health) is the direct object of принесет (will bring).

cases.sentence: Чти Господа своим ___, первыми плодами от всех своих урожаев.
cases.translation: Honor the Lord with your substance, with the first fruits of all your harvests.
cases.explain: The instrumental case shows the means by which you honor the Lord.

cases.sentence: Чти Господа своим достоянием, первыми плодами от всех своих ___.
cases.translation: Honor the Lord with your substance, with the first fruits of all your harvests.
cases.explain: After от (from), the genitive case indicates source.

cases.sentence: Это принесет здоровье твоему телу и укрепит твои ___.
cases.translation: This will bring health to your body and strengthen your bones.
cases.explain: Кости (bones) is the direct object of укрепит (will strengthen).

cases.sentence: Потому что мудрость выгоднее ___ и приносит больший доход, чем золото.
cases.translation: Because wisdom is more profitable than silver and brings greater return than gold.
cases.explain: In comparative constructions, the genitive case shows what is being compared.

reading.ru: Сын мой, не забывай моего поучения и в сердце храни мои повеления.
reading.question: Where should you keep your father's commandments?
reading.explain: The text says to keep the commandments in your heart.

reading.ru: Они продлят твою жизнь на много лет и принесят тебе мир.
reading.question: What will keeping your father's teaching bring you?
reading.explain: Keeping the teaching will add length of days and bring you peace.

reading.ru: Доверяй Господу от всего сердца и не полагайся на собственный разум.
reading.question: What should you not rely on?
reading.explain: The text says not to rely on your own understanding.

reading.ru: Блажен тот, кто находит мудрость, и человек, который обретает понимание.
reading.question: Who is blessed according to this verse?
options: Those who find wisdom and understanding
reading.correct: Those who find wisdom and understanding
reading.explain: The text says blessed is the one who finds wisdom and understanding.

reading.ru: Мудрость выгоднее серебра и приносит больший доход, чем золото.
reading.question: What is wisdom more valuable than?
reading.explain: Wisdom is more profitable than silver and brings greater return than gold.

reading.ru: Дерево жизни она для тех, кто ею владеет, счастливы те, кто ее удержит.
reading.question: What is wisdom compared to for those who possess it?
reading.explain: Wisdom is called a tree of life for those who hold onto it.
